text: I think you'll really enjoy this Banana Spice Bars recipe. It features large eggs, which are a staple in many of the recipes you've liked in the past. The addition of ripe bananas and warm spices like cinnamon, clove, and allspice also seem to be right up your alley, given your fondness for desserts. The fact that it's ready in about 45 minutes is also consistent with the cooking time of many recipes you've liked, so I think you'll find it a great fit for your tastes.
